infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FacePass requires camera access to capture classroom attendance snapshots and walkthrough videos for biometric verification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FacePass requires photo library access to upload classroom group photos or videos for biometric attendance verification.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FacePass requires microphone access when recording classroom walkthrough videos.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow FacePass to access your camera for classroom biometric attendance scanning.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow FacePass to access your microphone when recording walkthrough videos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow FacePass to select classroom group photos and walkthrough videos for attendance processing.
